aboutText:
Hi, I'm Ömer, a React Native developer with 4 years of experience building cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android. I work with React Native, Expo and TypeScript on app architecture, state management (Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Context API) and REST/GraphQL API integration. I handle the full app lifecycle, from Firebase integration and CI/CD workflows to App Store and Google Play releases.

My journey started in high school at Madenler Vocational and Technical Anatolian High School, where I learned C#; in my third year I moved into web design and discovered front-end development. I deepened that interest by studying Software Engineering at Karadeniz Technical University, learning the theoretical and engineering side of software with C++ and Java. During the pandemic, trying to build my own website showed me what I was missing, and that pushed me into front-end development in a structured way. I built web projects first, then moved to mobile, a natural next step for my web skills, and started working with React Native.

Today I focus on building reusable, accessible and performant interfaces, solving platform-specific issues, and maintaining scalable codebases with collaborative Git workflows. I use AI tools for prototyping, coding, debugging and documentation, and always review and validate their output. I use this site as a personal space to share my professional work and document my journey in software.
experienceIsinolacakDesc: Working on-site, I built an AI-powered mobile job application app with React Native. I played an active role in every stage, from the initial idea to release. I designed the app's technical architecture, developed its features and carefully managed code quality. By keeping task tracking and planning consistent throughout, I helped the project reach a sustainable structure.
experienceApprilDesc: Working freelance and remotely, I brought a live score mobile app built with Flutter to life. I structured the app to be clean and maintainable. I optimized screens and components for performance, and designed and built reusable UI components to keep the app consistent throughout.
experienceCoinoDesc: Working remotely, I built crypto trading and sports betting apps with React Native. I also contributed to a blockchain education mobile app built with Flutter. Across these projects, I focused on keeping the apps' structure clean and maintainable, and on running team coordination and task tracking effectively.
experienceSellmifyFreelanceDesc: Rejoining this project on a freelance basis, I worked with the team on our own product. I focused on improving the performance and code structure of the React Native mobile app. I also took an active role in building the landing page and admin panel with React, helping both the mobile and web sides become more maintainable.
experienceNoxarcDesc: Working remotely, I built a live Q&A mobile app with React Native. I helped keep the project's structure on track and ran the team's task tracking in a planned way.
experienceSellmifyFulltimeDesc: In my first job, I joined a project run on a hybrid model. I supported the development of a second-hand marketplace mobile app with React Native. I also built the landing page with React and contributed to the admin panel. By helping create a shared structure across mobile and web, I aimed to keep the projects moving in an organized, sustainable way.
